A luxurious 17th-century Dutch still life scene. An ornate, silver-gilt tazza holds a meticulously crafted banana split, where the banana is perfectly ripe, and the ice cream is delicately sculpted and dusted with real gold leaf. Melted chocolate syrup pools elegantly on the silver plate. The background features heavy, dark velvet drapes, scattered exotic seashells, a half-peeled lemon, and a glowing glass of wine. The mood is opulent, quiet, and reflective of the wealth of the Dutch Golden Age.

Lighting: Single-source, directional window light from the upper left, creating dramatic chiaroscuro, deep shadows, and luminous highlights on the glass and silver.
Adjectives: Opulent, dramatic, classical, rich.
